synonyms: サカモト デイズ 2クール
description:
The legendary former hitman Tarou Sakamoto has thwarted numerous assassins after an enormous bounty on his head was issued. But he cannot seem to catch a break and simply take it easy with his beloved family. A mysterious and infamous figure known as Slur has brought a group of insane death row inmates to Japan, who hold back from nothing to eliminate their targets.

Sakamoto is not the only target—the criminals have been assigned to kill various other people, including the new hires at Sakamoto's convenience store, Shin Asakura and Lu Shaotang. The situation escalates even further when the Order, a group of the most skilled Japanese assassins, becomes involved. As the inmates begin wreaking havoc, Sakamoto and his allies must remain vigilant for the sake of everything they hold dear.

(Source: MAL Rewrite)

Note: The series is streaming a week in advance on Netflix Japan starting with episode 2 released alongside episode 1.

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

__Height:__ 190 cm

Nagumo is an old friend of [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou). He is a member of "The Order", a group of assassins who are the highest ranked in the JAA. He's first seen paying a visit to Sakamoto to inform him of his bounty.

__Height:__ 188 cm

Tarou Sakamoto is a retired hitman. He was the greatest hitman, feared and revered by bad guys and hitmen everywhere. However, he left the hitman world in order to be with his wife. He currently owns a store, and has one child. He is the jack of all trades of his town, and is very popular and well liked by people in his town.

__Height:__ 175 cm

Osaragi is an assassin and a new member of the Order, a group of powerful assassins that work under the JAA.

__Height:__ 172 cm

Shin is a ex-hitman turned employee who works for [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou). He has the ability to hear the thoughts of those around him.

__Height:__ 165 cm

Lu Shaotang is the daughter of a Triad Family, which is always being hunted down for their wealth and to get revenge for the past actions of the family. She meets [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou) when he saves her from assassins sent to steal a key to her family's safe. In return, she would make pork buns for him and has worked at Sakamoto's store since.

~!Lu likes to drink, causing her to go into a "drunken mode" which powers her up in combat.!~

*Note: Lu was introduced with the wrong hanzi (小糖 instead of 少糖) which made her name Romanize as Xiaotang. In the first volume the mistake was noted and corrected, revealing her name should have been Shaotang. However, in the English release, Viz decided to keep using Xiaotang and have not corrected her name.*

__Height:__ 180 cm

Heisuke Mashimo is a low-ranking assassin whose main skill is sharpshooting. Heisuke ended up losing his job, causing him to seek out [Tarou Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Tarou-Sakamoto)'s bounty in order to turn his luck around.

Gaku is an extremely powerful assassin under [Slur](https://anilist.co/character/272878/Uzuki). He wields a long cube-headed mace, the tip of which contains a powerful cannon. He usually covers this weapon with bandages. 

~!He was able to massacre hundreds of JAA members and hold his own against [Takamura](https://anilist.co/character/272875/), an especially strong Order member. However he does permanently lose his right ear as a result of this fight.!~

__Height:__ 164 cm

Akira Akao is one of the examinees taking part in the JCC Exam. She is the niece of [Rion Akao](https://anilist.co/character/288224), Nagumo's and Sakamoto's old classmate.

__Height:__ 179 cm

Uzuki, also known as Slur, is a killer seeking to overthrow the JAA. Roughly around the same time [Tarou Sakamoto's](https://anilist.co/character/196522) bounty was put up, Uzuki murdered a quarter of the assassin industry. The Order deemed him "X" as he leaves a large red 'X' at the scene of his crimes.
An old man carrying a katana. He is an assassin from The Order, a group consisting of the strongest members within the JAA.

__Height:__ 180 cm

Shishiba is an assassin and member of The Order, a group of powerful assassins tasked with keeping the order within the Japanese Assassin Association (JAA). His weapon of choice is a claw hammer.

An old friend of [Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Tarou-Sakamoto) and [Nagumo](https://anilist.co/character/264336/Nagumo) from their time as students at JCC. Rion is [Akira](https://anilist.co/character/287914/Akira-Akao)'s aunt, having taught her how to see the "paths" which lead to a person's death. Her current whereabouts are completely unknown.

A former employee of the Okutabi Lab, as well as one of its latest and most successful test subjects. Currently a student at the JCC, where he works as the Weapon Production Department Leader. Seba wears a special black-colored suit which enables him (or whatever the material is covering) to become invisible at will. He is the older brother of [Mafuyu](https://anilist.co/character/288277/Seba-Mafuyu).

Aoi is the wife of [Tarou Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou) and mother of [Hana Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/272877/Sakamoto-Hana). She met Tarou at a convenience store where he fell in love with Aoi. Soon after the two married and had a daughter. Shortly after meeting, Aoi expressed her feelings about death and convinced Sakamoto to retire as a hitman and not kill anymore.

One of the very skilled examinees taking part in the JCC transfer exam in order to become an assassin. Mafuyu is a germaphobe, going to extreme lengths to avoid dirty things and reacting with incredible disgust whenever he gets dirty. In fact, he won't even use his hands in battle due to not wanting them to get filthy, opting to use blades hidden inside his shoes in order to fight. He is the younger brother of [Natsuki Seba](https://anilist.co/character/288223/).

One of the three members of the special recommendation group in JCC Transfer Exam. She wears a school uniform and has a Sakamoto keychain attached to her bag. She is an otaku and a hardcore Sakamoto fan. Toramaru's weapon of choice is a combination of a gun and an axe, making her deadly from any distance.
Hana Sakamoto is daughter of [Tarou Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/196522/Sakamoto-Tarou) and [Aoi Sakamoto](https://anilist.co/character/212302/Sakamoto-Aoi).

One of the three members of the special recommendation group in the JCC Transfer Exams. He is always seen wearing an ushanka, which his eyes are often shadowed by. Kaji is an extremely shy person who frequently overthinks any actions he's about to take. As such, he remains silent and/or inactive most of the time. Kaji has vastly superhuman hearing, which allows him to mimic an enemy's movements through hearing alone.

A serial killer (206 victims) and death row inmate who, alongside fellow serial killers Minimalist, Dump, and Saw, was able to fake his death and escape to Japan with the help of [Uzuki](https://anilist.co/character/272878/Uzuki).

An assassin and member of The Order, making him one of the most powerful members of the JAA. He sports a metallic jaw-piece on his lower jaw, wears two large chain necklaces, and has many piercings. Despite being colleagues, Hyou finds [Nagumo](https://anilist.co/character/264336) untrustworthy and often shows hostility towards him.

In chapter 127: ~!Hyou is killed by [Kumanomi](https://anilist.co/character/307048/) in Thailand.!~

Extremely powerful assassin, first introduced as a test administrator during the JCC Transfer Exam. 

He is also a renowned film director and the pioneer of "assassin movies." Due to his passion for filmmaking, Kanaguri always carries a film camera with him, has a film-reel shape shaved into the left side of his head, and wraps himself in a long scarf with the appearance of a film strip. He possesses a clapperboard sharp enough to decapitate someone and withstand a shot from an M60 light machine gun.
Kashima is a subordinate of [Slur](https://anilist.co/character/272878/Uzuki-Kei).

A serial killer (180 victims) and death row inmate who, alongside fellow serial killers Minimalist, Apart, and Saw, was able to fake her death and escape to Japan with the help of [Uzuki](https://anilist.co/character/272878/). Dump has extendable spikes hidden in her body (2 in each hand, 6 across her torso), and is able to extend them a significant distance with great force. She is fascinated with finding love, but unfortunately for her love interests, she finds people the cutest when they are about to die.

~!She is killed by [Osaragi](https://anilist.co/character/266969/).!~
Member of The Triad who has had a crush on [Lu Xiaotang](https://anilist.co/character/207272/Lu-Xiaotang) since they were kids. He is sent to Japan to retrieve her from working at Sakamoto's.

A serial killer (370 victims) and death row inmate who (alongside fellow serial killers Dump, Apart and Saw) was able to fake his death and escape to Japan with the help of [Uzuki](https://anilist.co/character/272878/Uzuki).  Minimalist is an incredibly proficient serial killer. His modus operandi is to crush his victims into small balls with his bare hands. 

~!He was killed and beheaded by [Nagumo](https://anilist.co/character/264336/Nagumo) in Sakamoto's store!~
One of the examinees taking the JCC Transfer Exam, this being his fifth attempt.

One of the three Special Recommendations for the JCC test, being Test Taker 208. ~!It was later revealed that Gaku was remotely controlling his body after duping Shinaya into the job. A hijacked Shinaya was then used to scout out JCC applicants.!~
One of the examiners in the JCC transfer exam.

An assassin working under [Slur](https://anilist.co/character/272878/Uzuki-Kei). Club Jam has pink, dreadlock-esque hair and has tattoos of the words "Sweet" and "tooth" replacing his eyebrows. He is extremely masochistic, but also very playful.

He has a close relationship with [Carolina Reaper](https://anilist.co/character/288281/Carolina-Reaper) despite the latter's crude and hostile attitude.

A serial killer (64 victims) and death row inmate who (alongside fellow serial killers Dump, Apart and Minimalist) was able to fake his death and escape to Japan with help from [Uzuki](https://anilist.co/character/272878/Uzuki). Saw believes that people live boring lives, and one way to make them interesting is to give them a sublime death, much like a moving or dramatic death scene in a manga or movie. He uses a chipped axe with a wooden handle in battle. He often combines this with a length of rope, turning it into a brutal ranged weapon.

~!He is defeated by [Shin](https://anilist.co/character/196521/Shin) and [Lu Xiaotang](https://anilist.co/character/207272/Lu-Xiaotang), and then killed by [Hyou](https://anilist.co/character/288288/Hyou).!~
A hollistic healer.
Assassin for Slur working undercover as an agent at the JAA.
Assassin working for the JCC. Led a group of assassins defending against [Gaku](https://anilist.co/character/288279).
Head Examiner of the JCC Transfer Exam.
Examiner for the JCC Transfer Exam.
